title: Australian Crumble
description: A simple and delicious dessert featuring a mix of almonds and nutty flavors topped with a crunchy crumble.
instructions: Mix together the sliced almonds and chopped nutty in a bowl.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour and granulated sugar.
Add the cold unsalted butter to the flour mixture and mix until crumbly.
Press half of the crumb mixture into the prepared baking dish.
Add the almond mixture on top.
Top with the remaining crumb mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
